authorization.agent_policy: No agents used or requested in this task.
authorization.execution: This task explicitly requests design only. Existing continuation does not authorize this proposed new training campaign within this task; this plan grants no execution authority. A later explicit go is required after concrete v3 source, registration, and review are ready.
authorization.preparation: Existing user direction to fix blockers and keep going authorizes bounded preparation and design.

evidence_limits: No checkpoint decoded or imported in this task.
No model/native execution, inference, training, or runtime measurement performed.
No qualification, promotion, student, B/E, D3, or held-out claim.
Source code and policy files were read only for contract inspection.

inrun: finite losses/rewards/gradients and reward accounting; nonzero actor and critic gradients
report evaluations at 0/24/48 as measured; survival Q1/Q4/mean, score diagnostic only, death causes
no stage advance until same final checkpoint passes complete D2 survival mean >=3060; no D3 or B/E qualification
prelaunch: Prospective runner is migrated and frozen to teacher_qualification_v3_survival_only; no score pass/fail predicate.
Exact accepted D1 checkpoint identity and D1 terminal receipt revalidated; no diagnostic or failed D2 checkpoint imported.

Fresh D2 config permits only registered phase, difficulty, pattern, run-seed, development-cap and phase-derived mode/budget changes. Reward, learner settings, architecture, source/native/runtime identity, and 6 GiB limits stay fixed.

Independent frozen review and parent registration/pin audit pass; one run ID, empty output, no old lease conflict, distinct valid D2 training seed namespace, and new exact-once authorization are registered.

Prospective qualification policy and run protocol hashes pinned; fresh runner enforces v3, and identity/transition validation accepts only newly registered v3 identities without weakening historical v2 validation.
terminal: exact parent acceptance of all receipts and input hashes, exit 0, <=1800 seconds, resource evidence within separate caps, and owned process absence
if incomplete, failed, or gate not passed: preserve evidence, no retry, no promotion; future campaign requires separate design and authorization

protocol.cooperative: One owned process group; fail closed at every boundary; no retries; retain partial evidence on failure; parent observes exit, wall, resources, artifacts, and process absence before terminal acceptance.
protocol.memory_interpretation: Separate cooperative RSS and sampled MPS ceilings; report sample limits and do not claim unsampled continuous peak coverage.
protocol.wall_basis: Observed diagnostic was 796.99 seconds for 48 updates including run overhead. Proposed 1500-second work allowance is 1.88x that observed full duration; remaining 300 seconds reserved. Stop at completed update boundary on work deadline; no retries. This is conservative measured headroom, not a promise of completion.

rationale.critic: All 48 same-batch pre/post fits improved; arithmetic means EV 0.6098003 to 0.7033030 and residual MSE 0.0273812 to 0.0196050. This does not establish a failure threshold or critic-caused policy harm.
rationale.gate: D2 survival threshold is 3060 mean frames; diagnostic cohort did not pass.
rationale.historical_reference: Historical best from separate 384-update run, selected among 24 development evaluations: Q1=648.25, Q4=4508.8125, mean=2240 frames. Different cohort and selection rule; descriptive context only, no duration-confounded inference.
rationale.performance: Named cohort critic-diagnostic-D2-20261025-r2 update 48, fresh 64-seed development: survival Q1=521.0625, Q4=2401.1875, mean=1101.9375 frames. Update 0: Q1=165.4375, Q4=566.375, mean=295.25. Update 24: Q1=490.3125, Q4=1648.0625, mean=886.609375.
rationale.scope: Diagnostic covers only early D2. Its windows 9-16 and 41-48 differ in target and residual variance; it cannot explain late update-384 behavior. No arbitrary EV cutoff or causal interference claim.

recommendation.learner_settings: unchanged exact registered D2 learner settings
recommendation.name: fresh eligible D2 PPO iteration from accepted D1

required_source_change.not_included: No source edits in this design task. Do not toggle eligibility in diagnostic runner or rewrite diagnostic metadata.
required_source_change.scope: Prospective, narrowly scoped migration of training runner, development-gate import, and transition identity/config binding from frozen v2 predicate to v3 survival-only predicate. Preserve existing frozen v2 source, run receipts, failed-run metadata, and all historical identity checks. Add tests and freeze/review exact source before registering campaign.

supported_path: Use original D2 curriculum trainer/transition machinery only after prospective v3 migration is frozen and audited. Do not promote or resume diagnostic checkpoints. Avoid a new general-purpose runner; reuse existing supervision, receipts, and cooperative guard where compatible, with a small registered prospective adapter only if required by v3 migration.
